dogecoin.text: I saw new people buy doge coin and post the chart on their social media pages talkin bout “Betta get u some doge” and it’s already up 400%. I was like man y’all gonna get each other rekt buying something already up 400% then get silent when it drops 70%, when that’s when u buy.
Or they don’t have no money to buy back in because they used part of a stimulus check in the first place. Bought doge coin at .60 instead of between .01-.05. When u were supposed to.
People will pay top dollar for Bitcoin, dogecoin, whatever it is, and then sell it at the lower price, losing money. The name of the game is to buy low sell high.
